title: Register a member
description: Request: `{ "name": string, "email": string }`. Responds 201 with the member, or 400 / 409 with an error.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its interaction requirements.

title: Add a tool
description: Request: `{ "name": string, "description"?: string }`. Responds 201 with the catalog entry, or 400 with an error.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its interaction requirements.

title: List the catalog
description: No request body. Responds 200 with the catalog.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its interaction requirements.

title: Borrow a tool
description: Request: `{ "memberId": number, "toolId": number }`. Responds 201 with the loan, or 400 / 404 / 409 with an error. The checks run in one transaction.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its interaction requirements.

title: Return a tool
description: Request: `{ "condition": "good" | "needs_repair", "note"?: string }`. Responds 200 with the returned loan, or 400 / 404 / 409 with an error.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its interaction requirements.

title: Report damage to a tool
description: Request: `{ "note": string }`. Responds 200 with the catalog entry, or 400 / 404 / 413 with an error.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its interaction requirements.

title: Mark a tool repaired
description: No request body. Responds 200 with the catalog entry, or 404 / 409 with an error.
notes: Each rule for its body and responses is one of its interaction requirements.
